transaction_direction.description: Indicates whether the transaction added to (`credit`) or deducted from (`debit`) the wallet balance

value.description: The numeric value of the transaction amount

currency.description: The currency in which the transaction was processed

amount.description: The amount that was credited or debited in this transaction

before.description: Wallet balance before the transaction occurred

after.description: Wallet balance after the transaction was completed

balance.description: Wallet balance details before and after the transaction

value.description: The value of the amount originally sent, represented as a string to preserve formatting (e.g., precision)

currency.description: The currency of the originally sent amount

sent_amount.description: The original amount sent or requested in the transaction, which may differ from the final amount due to fees, currency conversion, or adjustments

transaction_type.description: Categorizes the nature of the transaction

transaction_date.description: The date and time when the transfer was submitted for processing

id.description: The unique identifier for the transfer

type.description: The type of transfer, indicating the method used to transfer funds

action.description: Whether to process the transfer instantly or at a later date

reference.description: A custom identifier to track the transaction, This must be unique across all your transactions

initial_status.description: The original status of the transfer before reversal

narration.description: A brief description or message accompanying the transfer, provided by the sender to describe the purpose of the transfer

value.description: Amount to be sent to the recipient. This is a positive integer in the smallest currency unit

applies_to.description: Specifies whether the transfer amount is in destination_currency (no conversion) or source_currency (this will be converted to destination currency)

value.description: The amount charged as a fee for the transfer

actual_debit_amount.description: The exact amount deducted for the transfer, including applicable fees

rate_used.description: The exchange rate applied to calculate the transfer amount

vat.description: The Value-Added Tax (VAT) amount charged for the transfer

amount_credited.description: The exact amount credited to the recipient's account after the transfer is processed, which may differ from the original transfer amount due to fees, exchange rates, or other adjustments

extra_information.description: Additional information about the transfer, which may include details such as the amount credited or any other relevant information that may be useful for the transfer

parent_id.description: The unique identifier of the original transfer that is being retried

parent_reference.description: The external reference of the original transfer that is being retried

retry.description: Contains the information of the initial transfer that was retried

parent_id.description: The unique identifier of the original transfer that is being retried

parent_reference.description: The external reference of the original transfer that is being retried

duplicate.description: Contains the information of the initial transfer that was duplicated

date_time.description: the scheduled date and time for when the transfer should be disbursed to the recipient's account. It should be in the 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' 24hr format

disburse_option.description: To specify the date and time for disbursement, this is required when action is set to scheduled

callback_url.description: A URL where callbacks or notifications will be sent

message.description: The processor message for the transfer

type.description: The type of the payout error, representing the specific error scenario

code.description: The unique code associated with the error type. This code follows a pattern of four digits

provider_response.description: Represents payout error codes. The `type` and `code` fields are separate enums where: - `type` indicates the nature of the error. - `code` provides the specific error code associated with the error type. - `message` explains the meaning of the `type-code` pair

date_of_birth.description: The customer's birthdate in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format
The customer's birthdate in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format

provider.description: Specifies the payment or service provider. Currently, only "flutterwave" is supported

identifier.description: A unique identifier assigned to the merchant by the payment or service provider

date_of_birth.description: The customer's birthdate in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format

country_code.description: The dialling country code e.g. 234 for NG

number.description: Unformatted 7-10-digit phone number without the country code

line1.description: The first line of the Customer's address

line2.description: The second line of the Customer's address

created_datetime.description: The date and time when the transfer was submitted for processing

transfer.description: Transfer-specific details, populated when the transaction type is related to a transfer
